marks.gloss_en: וכי תימא דלית בה זבת חלב ודבש -- והאמר ריש לקיש: לדידי חזי לי זבת חלב ודבש דציפורי
if you think Kitron is Tzippori, why did Zevulun resent his portion? Tzippori is a thing far superior
וכי תימא דלא נפישא דידיה כדאחוה -- והאמר רבה בר בר חנה אמר רבי יוחנן: ...עשרין ותרתין פרסי אורכא ופותיא שיתא פרסי
R' Yochanan: I myself saw the [land] flowing with milk and honey of all the Land of Israel, and it was from Bei Kovei to the fortress of Tulbakni, twenty-two parsa long and six parsa wide
דייקא נמי, דכתיב: ונפתלי על מרומי שדה. שמע מינה
אפילו הכי, שדות וכרמים עדיפא ליה (= p_sadot_uchramim_adifa)
answer: even so, fields and vineyards were preferable to him
מי איכא למאן דאמר רקת לאו טבריא היא? והא כי שכיב איניש הכא התם ספדי ליה הכי: ...ושם לו ברקת

when a man dies here, there they eulogise him: 'great was he in Sheshakh, and he had a name in Rakkat'; and when they bring the coffin up there: 'lovers of the remnant, dwellers of Rakkat, go out and receive the slain of the deep'
כי נח נפשיה דרבי זירא פתח עליה ההוא ספדנא: ...אוי נא לה, אמרה רקת
the eulogy for R' Zeira: the land of Shinar conceived and bore, the land of the deer raised her delights; 'woe to her', said Rakkat, 'for she has lost her precious vessel'

וקטרון ציפורי היא? והא קטרון בחלקו של זבולון הואי... וזבולון מתרעם על מדותיו הוה... ואי סלקא דעתך קטרון זו ציפורי, אמאי מתרעם? (6a.9) -- with two וכי תימא pre-emptions refuted by Reish Lakish and R' Yochanan (supports below)
Kitron was in Zevulun's portion, as written: 'Zevulun did not drive out the inhabitants of Kitron or of Nahalol' (Judg 1:30)
Chamat is Tiberias
rather, Rabbah: Chamat is the hot springs of Gerar
Zeira: Kitron is Tzippori
Zevulun before the Holy One: to my brothers You gave fields and vineyards and to me mountains and hills; to my brothers lands, and to me seas and rivers
Rav Yosef teaches: 'treasures' -- this is the chilazon
'and Ekron shall be uprooted' (Zeph 2:4) -- this is Caesarea, daughter of Edom
R' Yosei bar Chanina on Zech 9:7: 'I will remove his blood from his mouth' -- this is their house of altars
'and he too shall remain for our God' -- these are the synagogues and study halls in Edom
R' Yitzchak: Leshem is Pamyas

Caesarea and Jerusalem: if a man tells you both are destroyed, do not believe; both settled, do not believe; Caesarea destroyed and Jerusalem settled, or Jerusalem destroyed and Caesarea settled -- believe
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: from here -- 'and one people shall be stronger than the other' (Gen 25:23)
Isaac before the Holy One: Master of the world, let favour be shown to Esau ... [answered 'he is wicked'] Isaac said: 'he has not learned righteousness' (Isa 26:10)
Jacob before the Holy One: Master of the world, do not grant the wicked Esau his heart's desire (Ps 140:9)
